# Pull request

## Outcome

What user, contributor, or control outcome changed?

## Why

Link the issue/RFC and summarize evidence, alternatives, and tradeoffs.

## TARMAC impact

- [ ] Triage
- [ ] Architecture
- [ ] Release
- [ ] Monitoring
- [ ] Automation & CI/CD
- [ ] Compliance & Governance
- [ ] Foundation/documentation only

## Control impact

- [ ] No lifecycle-control impact
- [ ] Lifecycle gate or state-transition behavior changed
- [ ] Data model, evidence, or auditability changed
- [ ] Security, privacy, authorization, or retention changed
- [ ] Public metric/value calculation changed

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:foundation`
- [ ] `npx prisma validate`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant positive and negative workflow behavior verified

## Documentation and repository safety

- [ ] Public numbers are labeled observed, estimated, modeled, hypothesis, or target and link to a method.
- [ ] Material architecture changes include or update an ADR.
- [ ] Examples and screenshots contain synthetic, non-confidential data.
- [ ] No credentials, `.env`, production data, symbolic links, or generated dependency folders are included.
- [ ] This contribution does not change or imply a license; All Rights Reserved remains in force.
